title: Candidate Capsule Schema v0.1 (developer preview / non-production)
description: Minimal candidate schema for a RIO intent capsule used by the Portable Constitutional Engine Gate Simulator reference implementation. This is a candidate developer-preview schema, not a certified or production data contract.

capsule_id.description: Unique candidate identifier for this capsule instance.

sourcepoint_id.description: Identifier of the sourcepoint (human or system) that originated the intent.

intent.description: Plain-language statement of the requested action.

scope.description: Candidate scope label for the requested action (e.g. draft, read, send, delete).

consequence_class.description: Candidate consequence classification used by the Gate Simulator.

return_path.description: Candidate receipt destination, expected to use a receipt:// scheme in this reference implementation.

authority_envelope_ref.description: Reference to the authority envelope backing this capsule. Presence only; this schema does not verify cryptographic authority.

metadata.description: Free-form candidate metadata (e.g. register, model_office, coherence_warning).
